entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit, your partner in performance. For questions about an existing order, press 1. For product support, press 2. To speak with a representative, press 3.
Ugh, three.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit customer support. My name is Ben. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to return a VeloBand Pulse that I bought. It's just not working out for me.
I can certainly look into that return for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF-8675309.
Got it. One moment... Okay, I see the order. It was delivered about two weeks ago. To proceed, I just need to confirm, has the VeloBand been opened and used?
Of course it's been used. How else would I know I don't like the heart rate tracking? I wore it for about ten days.

I understand. Unfortunately, per VeloFit's return policy, we are unable to accept returns on wearable fitness trackers once they have been opened and used. This is for hygiene and data privacy reasons.
What? That's ridiculous. I'm well within your 30-day return window. You can't just refuse a return.
I see you are within the 30-day timeframe, sir, but our policy on used health devices is an exception to that. I can offer you a 20% off coupon for your next VeloFit purchase for the trouble.
A coupon? Are you kidding me? That is completely unacceptable. I don't want another one of your products, I want my money back for this one. I need to speak to your boss immediately.
Sir, I am empowered to resolve these issues, and I can assure you my manager would provide you with the same information. The policy is firm on this.
I don't believe that. This is terrible customer service. Put your supervisor on the phone right now. I want to speak to a manager.
Okay. I will see if one is available. Please hold one moment.
Hello, this is Maria, a customer support supervisor at VeloFit. I understand you're requesting to speak with me about a return for a VeloBand Pulse?
Yes, finally. Your agent is refusing to process my return. I've had the product for two weeks and I'm not satisfied with it. This policy about not returning used items is unacceptable.

I do understand your frustration, and I've reviewed your order details. While I wish I had a different answer for you, Ben was correct. Our policy, which is stated on the product page before purchase, does not allow for returns of opened and worn health monitoring devices for sanitary reasons. We cannot restock them.
So you're telling me the same thing? That I'm just stuck with a $150 piece of plastic I don't want? This is unbelievable. I will be filing a dispute with my credit card company.
I'm very sorry that we couldn't come to a more agreeable resolution for you today. Is there anything else I can help with?
No. You haven't helped with anything. You've just lost a customer.
